test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only three people sit to the left of P. Only R sits to the right of Q. Only three people sit between Q and O. X sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of W.

How many people sit between W and Y?
solution:
Given: O, P, Q, R, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

1) Only three people sit to the left of P.

2) Only R sits to the right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/148565650419c5fa985d26fabc54236f728fc232d6102fd10743e47c025c7372.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/655dc5c339ee4554a07216d299d6ec21d8f39976c2929e94f0f0e88923e23408.png] 

3) Only three people sit between Q and O.

4) X sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52ebe21ad2471d8c54f0022b884596ef379e0862a6bc325bee19290f85267b28.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1edc0339bf4384f23f88e077b948e5bd656f90d6ddc5b70387b5a407c375957c.png] 

Thus, three people sit between W and Y.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
